Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The skid recovery diagram is a picture; only its step captions and the written instructions were used [A03].
The winter page's advice to pump the brakes on very slippery surfaces and the anti-lock page's advice not to pump are kept apart with the guide's own condition, the owner's manual for anti-lock vehicles [A02].
The passenger van paragraph reports a federal safety board finding and recommendation, restated in original words; the board's web address was not turned into a fact [A05].
Headlight hours and the wiper headlight rule are isolated as dynamic.
